name: National Haze Action Plan (Pelan Tindakan Jerebu Kebangsaan, PTJK), as applied to schools by the Ministry of Education (KPM)

closure.summary: Schools in the affected area close immediately once the IPU reading reaches 200.
closure.note: The Education Minister's 15 Oct 2026 statement says schools close when the reading reaches ('mencecah') 200; some reports word it as 'exceeds 200'. The two differ only at exactly 200. This dashboard counts 200 itself as reaching the threshold.

outdoor.summary: All outdoor activities stop when the IPU is above 100.

how_applied: Official closure announcements come first: where Bernama has reported an announced closure covering the place and date, the site shows it as officially closed, whatever the IPU reading. The IPU check is then shown only for reference.
Reading used: the hourly IPU published by DOE APIMS for the reference monitoring station (the nearest station with a current reading).
Threshold reached today: the latest reading, or any hourly reading earlier today (Malaysia time), is 200 or more.
If reached: the dashboard says schools in the affected area may be closed tomorrow. PTJK closure takes effect immediately, so a closure may already apply today.
If not reached: the dashboard says the closure threshold has not been reached at the latest available reading. This can change if readings rise later.
Weekends and year-end school holidays are shown as 'no school' days. Public holidays and state-specific holidays are not included.
No prediction is shown when the reference station has no reading from the last 3 hours.
who_decides: Closures are decided and announced by KPM, the state governments and education departments (JPN) and District Education Offices (PPD). This site shows announced closures only as reported by Bernama, checked twice a day at about 4 pm and 7 pm, and otherwise predicts from the IPU rule. Since 10 Oct 2026, State Education Directors announce daily school status based on DOE readings.

previous_rules.summary: Interim KPM rule: institutions closed from the next day where IPU exceeded 180, or where IPU exceeded 150 for three consecutive days. Replaced by the PTJK rule on 15 Oct 2026.
